structured_output.summary: Test-strength gap; no game behaviour changed. I added the stage 'overtake-twice' to src/ui/stages/hud-motion.stage.ts. It runs race(root, ...OVERTAKE, racing(1205, field(1))), so P3→P2 at tick 1201 is followed by P2→P1 at tick 1205, inside the first move's 10-tick window. I also updated the file's header comment to list it. The new test tests/ui/hud-motion-restart.test.ts renders 'overtake' and 'overtake-twice' in Chromium at 844×390. It checks that the second stage reads Pos 1, and that the Pos panel (0.16s stamp) and its digit (0.12s snap) still animate. It also checks that both run a different animation-name than after the first overtake, which proves the bump and roll restart. Red/green: with the mutation from the finding (deleting the is-again toggle at hud.ts:52), the test fails with "expected 'ui-hud-bump' not to be 'ui-hud-bump'". With hud.ts restored, it passes. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (113 files, 743 tests).
